title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Manual Plant MagAttract v.1
author: Maja Todorovic

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a lysis buffer master mix consisting of the following components:

substeps.instruction: 200 µL Phosphate buffered solution (PBS)
20 µL Proteinase K
4 µL RNase A
150 µL Buffer AL

steps.title: Sample Preparation and Lysis
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 mg of cryogenically homogenised plant/fungi tissue from each sample to 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes and place on dry ice to keep frozen.

substeps.instruction: Add 374 µL of the lysis buffer master mix to each sample.
Homogenise sample and mastermix by gently pipetting 10 times with a wide bore pipette tip.
Centrifuge tubes briefly in a mini centrifuge to collect contents.
Incubate on the heat block at 50 °C for 2 hours.
Remove sample tubes from the heat block and briefly centrifuge in a mini centrifuge to spin down.
Using a wide-bore pipette tip set to 380 µL, transfer lysate to individual microcentrifuge tubes, avoiding insoluble material.

steps.title: Bead Binding
steps.instruction: Bind the DNA to the magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 280 µL Buffer MB and 15 µL of Suspension G beads to each sample.
Invert the tube 10–20 times to ensure beads are suspended in the lysate.
Allow 5 minutes for binding.
Briefly centrifuge the samples in a mini-centrifuge to collect at the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Initial Bead Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the beads from the lysate using a magnetic rack.

substeps.instruction: Place tubes on the magnetic rack and allow 2–5 minutes for beads to migrate (more viscous samples may take longer).
Remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: MW1 Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the beads with Buffer MW1.

substeps.instruction: Remove tubes from the magnetic rack and add 700 µL Buffer MW1 directly to the bead pellet.
Invert the tube 10–20 times to suspend the beads.
Place tubes on the magnetic rack for 2–5 minutes for beads to migrate.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Repeat this wash process for a total of two washes.

steps.title: PE Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the beads with Buffer PE.

substeps.instruction: Remove tubes from the magnetic rack and add 700 µL Buffer PE directly to the bead pellet.
Invert 10–20 times to resuspend the beads.
Place tubes on the magnetic rack for 2–5 minutes for beads to migrate.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Repeat this wash process for a total of two washes.

steps.title: Residual Buffer Removal
steps.instruction: Remove any remaining wash buffer from the tubes.

substeps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the tubes in a mini centrifuge.
Place the sample back on the magnetic rack.
Use a small micropipette to remove any residual wash buffer.

steps.title: Nuclease-Free Water Wash
steps.instruction: Perform a water wash on the beads.

substeps.instruction: While tubes are on the magnetic rack, pipette 700 µL nuclease-free water onto the side opposite of the beads (do not pipette directly onto the bead pellet).
Incubate for exactly 1 minute.
Slowly aspirate and discard the water from the tubes.
Repeat this specific water wash step for a total of two washes.

steps.title: First DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the purified gDNA from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Remove samples from the magnetic rack and add 200 µL of Buffer AE directly to the bead pellet.
Mix by gently flicking or using a wide-bore pipette tip to dislodge the pellet.
Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature, mixing gently halfway through and again at the end.
Briefly centrifuge (spin down) the sample in a mini centrifuge.
Place on a magnetic rack for 2–5 minutes for bead migration.
Using a 200 μL wide-bore pipette tip, carefully transfer the supernatant containing purified gDNA to a fresh microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Second DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Perform a second elution to maximize yield.

substeps.instruction: Remove the sample from the magnetic rack.
Add 200 μL Buffer AE to the bead pellet.
Incubate at 25 °C, shaking at 1000 rpm, for three minutes.
Centrifuge the tube briefly in a mini centrifuge.
Place on a magnetic rack for 2–5 minutes for the beads to migrate.
Using a wide-bore pipette tip, carefully transfer the supernatant containing purified gDNA to the same microcentrifuge tube used in the first elution.

steps.title: Storage
steps.instruction: Store the extracted gDNA sample at 4 °C.
